rootAuthorization: Prepare the bounded correction inside the existing protected executor and its existing test; no repository/control mutation or Cloud execution during preparation.

cause.description: The old snapshot retained Cloud Functions serviceConfig.revision only. The Preview rollback used it as the Cloud Run traffic destination, and the unchanged shortcut compared only Functions metadata. A prior routing rollback can leave the serving revision different from the Functions API revision.
cause.sourceReproduction: With Functions API revision wem and independently observed traffic cuy, the old restoration argument selects wem; the corrected owner selects cuy and requires a routing readback.

correction.readCredential: Existing protected executor GoogleAuth client; no new secret, principal, scope or permission.
correction.trafficEvidence: Cloud Run trafficStatuses observed revision, stable observed generation, service identity and successful readiness.
correction.snapshotSchemaCompatibility: GI_I66_MAKE_TRIGGER_SNAPSHOT_V1 and GI_I66_MAKE_TRIGGER_POSTIMAGE_V1 remain readable; new snapshots add typed independent traffic evidence.
correction.existingLegacySnapshotWithoutTraffic: HOLD before a restore or an unchanged claim; no inference from Functions API revision.
correction.historicalAbsentSnapshot: Preserves the exact observed-created-function deletion and absence-readback contract; no prior traffic inferred.
correction.liveExistingRollback: Still delegated to the existing LIVE revision owner; this proposal creates no new LIVE authority.
correction.postimage: Require the newly deployed API revision to be the independently observed serving revision, retain service identity and routing generation.
correction.rollback: Compare actual Functions and traffic postimages before the existing scoped traffic command, restore the single previously observed revision at 100 percent, and read it back independently.
correction.repeatedRollback: Returns verified already-restored with zero additional traffic writes when the current exact deployment already serves the prior observed target.
correction.preflightNoop: Requires both Functions projection and independently observed traffic to match the snapshot.
correction.supportedTraffic: Exactly one untagged serving revision at 100 percent. Multiple revisions, tagged/extra zero-percent targets, malformed values, unresolved readiness and unobserved generation fail closed.
correction.providerMutationAtomicity: Existing serialized workflow with exact before/readback checks; no claim of provider-level atomic compare-and-swap.

primaryReference.relevantContract: trafficStatuses describes observed traffic; routing values may be transient while reconciling. A completed successful reconciliation is identified by terminalCondition and matching generation/observedGeneration.

cases: legacy existing snapshot lacks routing evidence
failed auth or foreign resource rejection
project ID and project number normalization constrained to the exact service
